Any positive battery power passes.
results.severity_reason: Weak assertion in a plausibility test; no behaviour gap demonstrated (aero tier not run by instruction).
results.recommended_test_note: D V = 2.21 * 18 = 39.8 W and 39.8 / 0.3 = 132.6 W recomputed. But AVISTAR_DRAG_N has no 18.0 m/s key (17.75: 2.2065 N, 22.0: 2.3661 N), so 2.21 N is an interpolation to be stated as such, and whether the real P_bat lies below 133 W could not be checked without running the aero test.
results.note: Keep: it is the only real-solver check of battery-power; the lower bound P_bat > D V is physics and costs one line.
